title: Validated planning artifact paths
responsibility: Recognizes exact planning files and their ancestor directories only when the containing plan and contract hash are valid.

inputs.name: planningArtifactPaths.root
inputs.description: Repository root directory from which each listed plan.json under src/<category directory>/ is read, and from which the listed specification/units manifest of any plan whose unitId is not category.slug is read. Undefined or an empty string returns an empty set before any file is read.

inputs.name: planningArtifactPaths.files
inputs.description: Repository-relative, forward-slash paths that are the only candidates examined: each entry matching src/<pages|shells|layouts|components|functions|configs|services>/<directory>/plan.json is validated, and an artifact is accepted only if it is an entry here under a validated plan directory. Artifacts not listed here are never accepted, even when they exist on disk.

outputs.name: planningArtifactPaths
outputs.description: Set of accepted artifact paths, exactly as they appear in files, plus each ancestor directory of an accepted path ending in '/' (such as 'src/' and 'src/components/evidence-grid/' for 'src/components/evidence-grid/plan.json'). Plans that fail schema, location, contract-hash or unit-manifest checks and entries that are not supported artifacts under a validated plan directory contribute nothing; the function only reads files and changes none of them.
